record.title: Implement and verify a bounded source point-command sender
record.intent: Produce a typed single-command path with retained evidence and host-only transport controls.
requirements: Follow docs/research/rf-source-usb-control-decision.md and the typed Python workspace contract. Use a small reusable source package with Pydantic requests, Click endpoints and delegates; separate frame encoding, transport and evidence.

Encode the candidate MAX287x touchscreen point command, preserve the exact frame, allow one write only, bound input and output, and distinguish pre-write failure, uncertain write and transport completion from device acceptance.

Use explicit 115200/8N1 with no flow control, exclusive access, documented DTR/RTS and close behavior. Preserve pre-command bytes; fail closed before writing on unexpected input or setup errors. No automatic retry or port scan.

Validate known encoding vectors, bad external input, successful and silent PTY exchanges, pre-command input, setup/write/read failure and bounded receive overflow. Run workspace checks and installed-package checks as needed for a new package.
Commit and push implementation and control evidence before opening the physical source endpoint.
acceptance: Host-only evidence supports one bounded serial write with honest outcomes and raw evidence retention.
